en.headline: asset-inventory releases, meld-deepresearch milestones, OpenCode ecosystem
en.teaser: 17 asset-inventory releases, a four-release deep-research skill, and detailed bug reports filed across the OpenCode ecosystem.
en.overview:
### Work in own repositories
The window's largest effort went into `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, which moved through a dense chain of releases from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0. Early versions made the skill English-first with a paired Chinese doc set, then added seven fixed-string languages (ko/ru/ar/es on top of en/zh/ja), rendered bilingual sample pages, and a Material docs site. Later work fixed real defects: MCP enumeration silently dropped servers, `update.ps1` mishandled nested directories, and the language claim in `SKILL.md` could not be backed by the glossary; each fix came with a new checker rule so the gap could not reopen. The last releases added a version-consistency check, PR-triggered docs checks, a `🛑broken` state marker in seven locales, security guards for scanned content, a registry-first host-command scan, and a skills.sh one-line install.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` produced four releases. v0.2.0 wrote down the rule for unreachable sources, v0.3.0 split the skill into three cooperating skills (core research, spreadsheet analysis, and a third capability skill) with a cleaner reading copy and hard delivery gates, and v0.4.0 wrapped the six gate scripts behind a single `meld.py` CLI with prepare, render and review subcommands. The repository also gained a bilingual GitHub Pages landing page with light and dark themes, a Chinese README with a language switch, and validation scripts plus CI.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.0.0 through v1.4.0. The skill fetches the live OpenCode Go plan and recommends models per custom agent under budget, balanced and quality modes; later versions added a three-part output body with a data appendix, two discovery scripts (`discover-agents.mjs`, `snapshot-summary.mjs`), and shared helpers for BOM-tolerant JSON and proxy-aware re-runs.

Smaller own work covered `opencode-agent-sandbox`, where a `knowledge/` base was started and corrected for OpenCode V2 distribution, auth and Windows path pitfalls, and `opencode-skill-management`, where a `skill_management` plugin implementing list, inspect, disable and enable was built and its feasibility spec revised. `myBlog` received three OpenChamber screenshot samples.

### Upstream reporting
The bulk of outside activity was reporting: 29 issues and 9 discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`, covering multi-run MCP child processes that leak on deletion, a context-panel breakdown bar that always shows 其他 at 0%, browser captures exported at 1x on high-DPI displays, missing unlink affordances, and a model switch keeping the previous thinking level. In `anomalyco/opencode` twelve items were filed on MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision and Go endpoint image rejections, model listing after auth removal, and missing Windows CLI entry points. Smaller reports went to `oh-my-opencode-slim`, `OfficeCLI`, `SenseNova-Skills`, `SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` and `vercel-labs/skills`. PRs were opened in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` for CRLF frontmatter handling, review-server disposal, platform-specific browser opening and eval robustness, and one listing PR was opened against `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills`.

### Daily dashboard
`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` mostly ran automation that regenerates a profile activity dashboard, but also carried hand-written changes: activity copy switched to English, a 30-day activity card added, a daily workflow that rolls over every two hours, a fix ensuring statistics and their breakdowns cannot disagree, and CI bumped to checkout/setup-node v7 to leave the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

### Data notes
All 30 days of the window carry data. Because earlier dates were reconstructed through GitHub Search, those portions are approximate: star counts are unavailable and release coverage is limited to the user's own repositories.

zh.headline: asset-inventory 密集发版，meld-deepresearch 里程碑，OpenCode 生态问题上报
zh.teaser: asset-inventory 发布 17 个版本，深度研究技能连发四版，并在 OpenCode 生态各仓库提交了大量缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
### 自有仓库的主要工作
本窗口投入最多的是 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`，版本从 v1.3.0 一路推进到 v1.15.0。早期版本把技能改为英文优先并配套中文文档集，随后补齐七种固定字符串语言（在 en/zh/ja 之外加入 ko/ru/ar/es）、双语渲染示例页和 Material 文档站。之后集中修真实缺陷：MCP 服务器枚举被静默丢弃、`update.ps1` 处理嵌套目录出错、SKILL.md 的语言声明无法被词表支撑；每次修复都同步新增检查规则，避免问题再次出现。后期版本加入版本一致性检查、PR 触发的文档检查、七种语言的 `🛑broken` 状态标记、对扫描内容的安全约束、registry 优先的宿主命令扫描，以及 skills.sh 一行安装。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 发布了四个版本。v0.2.0 把“来源打不开时如何处理”写成明确规则；v0.3.0 将单一技能拆成三个协作技能（核心研究、表格数据分析以及第三个能力技能），并配上干净阅读副本和硬性交付门禁；v0.4.0 用单一 `meld.py` 命令封装六个门禁脚本，提供 prepare、render、review 子命令。仓库还新增了明暗两套主题的双语 GitHub Pages 落地页、带语言切换的中文 README，以及校验脚本与 CI。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v1.0.0 至 v1.4.0。技能每次运行抓取实时 OpenCode Go 套餐，在 budget、balanced、quality 三种模式下为自定义 agent 推荐模型；后续版本加入三段式输出加数据附录、两个发现脚本（`discover-agents.mjs`、`snapshot-summary.mjs`），以及兼容 BOM 的 JSON 读取和带代理重跑的公共辅助函数。

其余自有工作包括：`opencode-agent-sandbox` 建立并修订 `knowledge/` 知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 分发、认证与 Windows 路径坑；`opencode-skill-management` 实现 list/inspect/disable/enable 的 `skill_management` 插件并修订可行性规范；`myBlog` 新增三张 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游问题上报
外部活动以报告为主：在 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交 29 个 issue 和 9 个讨论，涉及多轮运行删除后残留 MCP 子进程、上下文面板占比条让“其他”恒为 0%、高 DPI 屏幕上浏览器截图按 1x 导出、agent 关联项无法解除关联、切换模型后仍沿用上一个思考等级等。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交 12 个条目，集中在 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 视觉与 Go 端点拒收图片、认证文件删除后模型仍在列表、Windows 缺少 CLI 入口等。另有报告提交给 `oh-my-opencode-slim`、`OfficeCLI`、`SenseNova-Skills`、`SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` 和 `vercel-labs/skills`。在 `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 开了多个 PR，涉及 CRLF 前言校验、卸载时释放 review 服务、按平台打开浏览器、评测健壮性；另向 `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 提交一个收录 PR。

### 个人主页看板
`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 以自动生成活动看板的机器提交为主，同时有手工改动：活动文案改为英文、新增近 30 天活动卡片、日报改为每 2 小时滚动更新、修正统计数字与拆分对不上的问题，并把 CI 的 checkout/setup-node 升级到 v7 以摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时。

### 数据说明
窗口内 30 天均有数据。由于较早日期通过 GitHub Search 回溯重建，这部分数据是近似值：星标数不可用，发布记录只覆盖本人仓库。

v0.2.0 明确了付费墙和机器人拦截来源的处理规则，并交付评测工作。
v0.3.0 将技能拆为三个协作技能，并加入硬性交付门禁。
v1.0.0 首个稳定版，默认只读地按套餐为各 agent 分配模型。
